protocol.purpose: Check the two combined candidates on different length distributions and predicate selectivities before choosing a retained implementation.
protocol.decision: Reject a candidate with a resolved regression on a distribution guard; investigate large unexplained regressions even when intervals are inconclusive. These are separate auxiliary workloads, never pooled with the primary SingleShotTime benchmark. Primary confirmation still requires fresh JVMs on all three original pool sizes.
controls: Every iteration runs for at least one second; a reported average per invocation may be shorter
Same committed auxiliary evaluator and tests in all versions
Full offset and original-object checks in setup, count checks on every invocation
No simultaneous timing, builds or tests
Original OptimizationBench and ScalingData are unchanged
